style: 3D cartoon, original design, office satire, slapstick
subject: ONE male spotted hyena, grey shirt-apron, hunched, toothy grin, clacking jaw
second_characters: ONE goat boss in a grey vest
props: ONE paper crown from a grid printout, grid lines only, no digits, no text; after the bite the same crown stays on his head, one corner missing; ONE plain pizza box, always in paws or in flight
environment: office stairwell by day: the hyena climbs steep concrete steps gripping a steel banister; tall windows; meerkats scurry up and down
motion_rule: the world flies at the hyena: everything drops and flies at him from above and below; camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves, each ending on the gag. He fills half the frame height, except the three close-up beats where a muzzle fills the whole frame. Cuts only at 5.4, 7.55, 9.1.

audio.pacing: one continuous delivery, no pauses between sentences; first word at 0.25; last word by 5.4; no words after 5.5
audio.pronunciation: me-NYA pa-VY-si-li. STAR-shiy YEST PER-vym. TUT PER-vym ga-la-DA-yet. za-TO f ka-RO-ne

timeline.a: a paper crown spins down the stairwell, flies across the lens; the hunched hyena catches it with both paws
close-up: on the steps, the hyena jams the crown on and lunges muzzle-first into the lens, muzzle filling the frame, mouth working
jaw working, the hyena grabs the banister, chest out, climbs two steps a stride; a meerkat below hurls a pizza box up over his head, it flies across the lens; banister bars in the foreground
timeline.c: low under the steps, whips up

timeline.a: jaw working, the hyena stretches on tiptoe from the top step, claws snatching air after the box, belly caving in; above, on the landing, the goat catches the box and chews a slice from it
timeline.c: over the goat's shoulder, snaps down

timeline.a: jaw working, the hyena hangs off the banister, chin up, nudges the crown with a claw, grinning; the goat licks his lips, peering at the crown from the landing
the hyena sniffs, twisting his whole body up and down the stairwell
the goat drops the empty box flat onto his chest; the hyena tumbles two steps down, crown stays on
the goat leans over the banister and bites one corner off the crown on his head, paper tearing; the hyena jerks upright; banister bars in the foreground
timeline.c: slides low through the banister bars

timeline.a: close-up: the goat lunges down into the lens chewing the corner, muzzle filling the frame; behind, on the steps, the hyena gropes the notch
timeline.c: head-on, jerking back from the goat

timeline.a: the hyena's belly growls, knees buckle, he slides down the banister hugging the box
crouched on a step, the hyena thrusts his muzzle and bitten crown into the lens, both filling the frame, box at his chest; grins, jaw clacking twice
timeline.c: low on the steps, jolting back

negative_prompt: text, digits, subtitles, watermark, logo, zoom, slow push-in, static wide shot, visible camera equipment, lifting hook, plate, bowl, dish, cutlery, dining table, chair, sitting, seated, counter, tray, cafeteria, kitchen, stands in place, closed mouth while speaking, a line said twice, an inserted word, speech after 5.5, foreign accent, feminine word endings, duplicate props, crown removed, bare head, a hero running at the camera on his feet
